Lemma

Xn⟹XX_n \Longrightarrow XXn​⟹X if and only if

∀f∈Cc(R):Ef(Xn)→Ef(X).\forall f \in C_c\p{\R} : \E f\p{X_n} \to \E f\p{X}.∀f∈Cc​(R):Ef(Xn​)→Ef(X).

Here, Cc(R)C_c\p{\R}Cc​(R) is the set of continuous functions on R\RR with compact support.
Proof.

The forward direction is trivial. For the reverse direction, let fff be a bounded continuous function. Given L>0L > 0L>0, we let

gL(x)≔{1if ∣x∣≤L,0if ∣x∣≥L+1,linearotherwise.g_L\p{x} \coloneqq \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } \abs{x} \leq L, \\ 0 & \text{if } \abs{x} \geq L + 1, \\ \text{linear} & \text{otherwise}. \end{cases}gL​(x):=⎩⎨⎧​10linear​if ∣x∣≤L,if ∣x∣≥L+1,otherwise.​

for these same nnn. In short, this allows us to pick LLL and nnn separately. Putting everything together,
